paper_metadata.title: Texture and mechanical properties of ultrafine-grained Mg–3Al–1Zn alloy sheets prepared by high-ratio differential speed rolling

evidence.quote: Mechanical properties and textures of the ultrafine grained (UFG) Mg–3Al–1Zn (AZ31) alloy with a mean grain size of 1/H9262m produced by high-ratio differential speed rolling were investigated.

evidence.quote: A cold AZ31 sheet with 2 mm thickness was subjected to the hot rolls maintained at 473 K. The diameters of the upper and lower rolls were identical (400 mm) and the ratio of upper to lower roll speed was set at 3. Rolling was conducted under non-lubricated condition.
